nom: The Ordinary Retinal 0.2% Emulsion High-Strength Retinoid Nighttime Treatment

segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers report the product left their skin softer and juicier overnight, though some also note it made skin dry or flaky before adjusting.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers frequently describe this as the most tolerable retinoid they've used, with several reporting no peeling, redness or burning, while a smaller number still experienced stinging, redness or eyelid burning early on.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers (including oily/combo) report visible pore reduction and smoother texture with no purging.
segments.oily: One oily/combination-skin reviewer reports no adverse reaction and clear improvement in texture and pore visibility despite regular, non-beginner use.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s-50s report reduced fine lines, firmer skin, faded dark spots and compliments on looking younger, some after months of consistent use.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers over 40 report smoother texture, reduced fine lines/wrinkles, firmer skin and diminished crow's feet, some over months of use; a few see only slight or no change in lines after weeks of use.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers note their skin felt smoother, softer or more hydrated after use, but others report the product itself made their face dry, especially early on or without a hydrating routine alongside it.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers describe temporary redness, tingling or a warm/hot sensation on application, especially when new to retinoids, while many others with sensitive skin report no redness at all.
concerns.barrier: Some reviewers report peeling, flaking or a small burn/scrape as skin adjusted (retinization), while others explicitly state no barrier disruption or irritation even with sensitive skin.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report visible fading of dark spots/hyperpigmentation from acne or sun within weeks to a couple of months; one reviewer used it over a month and saw no fading of dark spots.
concerns.blemishes: Some reviewers with acne-prone or hormonal breakouts report clearer skin or reduced new breakouts, including one describing hormonal acne vanishing within days; no reviewer reports the product caused new breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes the emulsion is not oily or greasy and absorbs without a sticky residue, contrasting with a previous oilier retinol product they had tried.

aspects.libelle: Yellow tint stains pillowcases and fabric
Tingling or warm sensation on application

extraits.texte: After only one use I cannot attest to its effectiveness but I can say that it stains. One of my favorite white linen shirts is now ruined. Although it's got a great price point, I would recommend the retinaldehyde from Paula's Choice instead. It works great and doesn't stain. I purchased this to use on my neck only. I'm bummed though.

I'm pretty much in love with this retinoid! It absorbs easily and is much less irritating than it could be. I wouldn't say it's not irritating though, I definitely had some retinization as my skin adjusted to it (namely redness, dryness, lots of flakes, and a small burn/scape on my cheek). And my skin is used to 1% retinol. My skin was also very sun sensitive, so sunscreen is a must. That being said, it's very effective, even after only one month. My skin has improved with less new acne, diminished old acne scars, and reduced fine lines, as well as evening my skin tone. The only downside to me is the price for the quantity, but I think it's still reasonable. Oh, and it's very very yellow, so you'll look jaundiced lol or bruised if you only use it for spot treatments. Gave my husband a good laugh though!

I received a sample size to try and as everyone knows you can not really get a good feel for skincare in samples. There's no miracle, works the very first time, cure all product. So I've been giving this my best go. I only applied weekly as instructed since I'm newer to retinols and do tend to be sensitive. I didn't have enough to work up to more than that. A pea size was all that was needed and it went on nicely, no immediate irritation and my skin felt smooth. In the morning my cheeks were redder than usual and after washing my face and doing my makeup I noticed only the days I had used this the night before, my makeup wouldn't sit well. It was separating and my pores seemed larger. My skin was softer though but a little dry although I already have dry skin. I feel over time my skin would adapt and it would be a good addition to my routine and luckily it won't break the bank either.

I've used this consistently for weeks now on my very sensitive, dry/combo skin - it's the best I've tolerated any form of retinol/retinal so far! It does tingle a bit when I put it on & my skin is a bit more sensitive on nights when I use it/the day after, BUT when I wake up in the morning after putting it on, my skin looks juicy, plump & fresh. Much more so than when I just use the other products in my routine!

This product is the hero of my routine. I'm 41, dry and sensitive, and using this serum nightly has given me some of the best skin of my life. People are frequently incredulous when they find out I'm a decade older than they assumed. Texture, tone, and general radiance are all much improved. I used to use the retinol in squalane for many years and switched to this when it was out of stock. At night, I wash, apply the serum, give it some time to sink in, and then go about the rest of my routine. Yes, it is slightly yellow- who cares, you should apply it at night! My pillowcases are dark colored silk so staining has not been an issue. Overall, you can't beat this for the price and my results shine for themselves.

I've been using this product for about three weeks and I am sold! My skin is more even, texture is disappearing, my pores are much less visible, and I've had zero adverse affects. I already have a back up on deck! I use niacinamide in addition to this serum. For reference: my skin type is oily/combo, I'm not a beginner retinol user, I'm melanated and I do not have sensitive skin.

After using the Cereve skin renewing retinol for years and results plateauing, I bought this product to take a small step up. I've used this for about 3 months now and my skin is in the best condition it's ever been! I started with once a week and now I'm up to using this most nights. When I have any acne/rosacea bump flare ups, this helps clear my skin so fast. I've definitely noticed a difference in texture and clarity. Plus it's so affordable! It definitely is bright yellow, doesn't smell great, and also doesn't spread super easily on the face but those are all things I'm willing to let go for the value.
